description: This grouped vertical bar chart, titled "Comprehensive Evaluation Results on Academic and Practical Benchmarks," illustrates the performance scores of four different models across various evaluation datasets. The horizontal axis, labeled "Dataset and Metrics," displays nine categories arranged from left to right: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, with the category labels rotated diagonally for readability. The vertical axis, labeled "Score (%)," represents the performance values on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with numeric tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 10. Within each category on the horizontal axis, the data is visually arranged into groups of four side-by-side bars, representing the different models defined in the legend titled "Model." The models and their corresponding bar colors are LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue), Ours (SFT baseline) (orange), Ours (DPO baseline) (green), and Ours (Iterative RLHF) (red). The heights of the bars vary across the datasets; the tallest bar in the chart is the red bar in the GSM-8K category, reaching a value of approximately 81%, while the shortest bar is the orange bar in the Chat-Arena-Hard category, indicating a value of approximately 6%. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted in a strict ascending, descending, or alphabetical order based on the data values, and none of the bars feature additional visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or outlining beyond their assigned legend colors.
